correctness.rationale: The fixed-point equation x=M^T x^[2] is F2-additive in characteristic two. If F2-independent fixed points admitted a minimal F_q dependence, Frobenius implies all coefficients c²=c, forcing F2 dependence; hence D=dim_F2 Fix≤n. Uniform GL_n(F_q) sends the frame of squared k-tuples to each chosen k-frame with probability reciprocal to frame count, giving factorial frame moments E[∏_{i=0}^{k-1}(2^D−2^i)]=1, identical to B uniform GL_n(F2). This triangular system determines the distribution. Gaussian-binomial inversion yields the displayed exact formula and standard product identity gives the n→∞ limit. Independently enumerated all 512 binary 3×3 matrices, selected 168 invertible matrices, and obtained fixed-vector frequencies 48,98,21,1 at counts 1,2,4,8, matching n=3 probabilities. Frozen verify.cpp was inspected (six cases, 205482 matrices), not used as an infinite proof.
